mentions.claim_text: He recalls a word that they would hack into the emergency call system and interfere with it, says a reported hack is that word coming to pass, and adds that this is practice: when the major event he saw takes place they will hack the 911 database as the distraction.
mentions.quote: they will hack into the 911 system and they will mess with it
mentions.falsify_match: A significant hack or outage of the US 911 emergency system, followed by a larger attack it covers.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such hack, or a hack with no following event. Note 911 outages have multiple ordinary causes and occur regularly, which lowers the bar.

mentions.claim_text: Standing on location by a field he says is several hundred years old, he recalls telling them that Bibles would be burned there, and describes a mound of Bibles five storeys high piled in the football stadium and set alight, comparing it to the book burning in an Indiana Jones film.
mentions.quote: they're going to burn the Bibles in the in the football stadium
mentions.falsify_match: A mass burning of Bibles at a named stadium.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such burning. Undated, so it cannot expire, but the location and the scale are specific enough to check.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had been praying over this for several weeks, and reports that Lindsey Graham suffered a massive heart attack at home in the middle of the night having just come back from abroad, calling the timing odd while stating he is not saying it was a conspiracy.
mentions.quote: he had a massive heart attack in his house in the middle of the night
mentions.falsify_match: An autopsy or investigation showing the death was not natural.
mentions.falsify_miss: A natural cause is confirmed. He hedges both ways in the same breath, and the antecedent word he points back to is not located in this corpus.
